note: Lindsey Graham (R) died July 11, 2026; his sister Darline Graham was appointed and won the GOP nomination in an Aug 25 runoff.

cands.name: Darline Graham
cands.desc: Appointed senator; former SC Commission for the Blind commissioner; backed for the seat by Donald Trump and Majority Leader John Thune.

cands.name: Annie Andrews
cands.desc: Pediatrician; won the Democratic primary with 61.5%.

cands.name: Alan Wilson
cands.desc: State attorney general since 2011; won the GOP runoff with 68.6% after Trump backed both runoff candidates.

cands.name: Jermaine Johnson
cands.desc: State representative; won the Democratic primary with 59.7%.
